title: 매크로를 더 ‘매크로’하게 봐야 한다…금리·유가보다 중요한 주도주의 흐름ㅣ명민준, 서수진, 이지환 [주린이 구조대]

claims.claim_text: Samsung Electronics and SK hynix each fell more than 5% after a holiday and rebounded the next day.

numeric_parse.claimed: >5% decline in each stock, followed by a rebound

claims.investor_implication: Do not treat the reported decline and rebound as confirmed price history.

claims.claim_text: Foreign futures net selling exceeded 6,000 contracts intraday, then reversed by over 4,000; program selling drove the semiconductor decline, and foreign traders had a margin exemption.
claims.investor_implication: Do not attribute the sell-off to derivatives flows without transaction-level verification.

claims.claim_text: Since July 29, retail investors net sold KRW 25 trillion of KOSPI stocks, about 44 million Samsung shares and 7 million SK hynix shares; Samsung foreign flows were over 10 million shares bought in the prior week and about 6 million sold on Monday, suggestin...

numeric_parse.claimed: KRW 25 trillion; 44 million and 7 million shares; >10 million bought then about 6 million sold

claims.investor_implication: Do not infer durable foreign sponsorship from these unverified net-flow figures.

claims.claim_text: Samsung and SK hynix had more low-price buying volume than high-price selling volume, SK Square showed the reverse with approximately a ten-year high in selling volume, and fewer than ten KOSPI 200/KOSDAQ 150 stocks met the speaker's criterion.

numeric_parse.claimed: Fewer than 10 qualifying stocks; SK Square selling volume near a ten-year high

claims.investor_implication: Do not use the claimed volume pattern as proof of leadership or distribution.

claims.claim_text: US ten-year and two-year Treasury yields were about 5.26% and 4.96%, the policy rate was 3.75%, and a hypothetical 25 bp rise plus a historical 1.24 percentage-point spread implied a 5.24% ten-year yield.

numeric_parse.claimed: 10Y 5.26%; 2Y 4.96%; policy 3.75%; 25 bp assumption; historical spread 1.24 pp; calculated 10Y 5.24%
numeric_parse.observed: Arithmetic confirmed; market inputs and historical average not supplied

claims.investor_implication: Do not anchor rate expectations to the unverified inputs or historical spread.

claims.claim_text: Stocks historically fell about 15% at the first rate hike and subsequently rose about 45%; POSCO rose from roughly KRW 250,000 to 750,000 within five to six months, suggesting a possible late-cycle semiconductor surge followed by a sharp fall.

numeric_parse.claimed: Average decline about 15%, later gain about 45%; POSCO KRW 250,000 to 750,000 in five to six months
numeric_parse.observed: No relevant historical series or methodology supplied

claims.investor_implication: Treat the late-cycle surge-and-crash scenario as a risk hypothesis, not an established pattern.

claims.claim_text: OpenAI deferred an IPO until next year, Goldman Sachs valued a current listing below USD 1 trillion, Anthropic might list in December, and associated fund rotation would affect hyperscaler ETFs more than semiconductors.

numeric_parse.claimed: OpenAI IPO next year; valuation below USD 1 trillion; Anthropic IPO in December

claims.investor_implication: Do not trade on the IPO schedule, valuation or proposed fund-rotation thesis without primary confirmation.

claims.claim_text: Battery, biotech and KOSDAQ gains on semiconductor down days reflect short-term position closing rather than new market leadership and may last fewer than two to three days.

numeric_parse.claimed: Strength may not persist two to three days

claims.investor_implication: Avoid treating this rotation explanation or its short duration as established.

claims.claim_text: Semiconductor equipment and materials suppliers differ in commodity and FX sensitivity; Samsung's claimed FX-related profit effect is small, and a 7:3 large-cap-to-supplier allocation was presented as an example.

numeric_parse.claimed: Ambiguous FX figure '7,억~9,억'; operating profit '100조'; 7:3 allocation example
numeric_parse.observed: Units unresolved; no disclosure data supplied

claims.investor_implication: Do not rely on the FX-profit comparison or allocation example as a validated sizing rule.

claims.claim_text: Micron earnings were scheduled for the 30th and Samsung results for early October; weak HBM4 guidance and a Micron sell-off could be a buying opportunity in Samsung and SK hynix.

numeric_parse.claimed: Micron results on the 30th; Samsung results in early October

claims.investor_implication: Verify the actual announcements and guidance before interpreting a sell-off as an opportunity.
